plato: Ensalada cesar con quesoo de cabra piñones y bacon

propuesta.prompt: @image1 is a real photo of goat cheese salad with crispy bacon, pine nuts and raisins from a Spanish tavern. Use it only as the list of elements, not as a layout to copy. The new photograph must contain the same real elements: a thick round disc of goat cheese with a caramelized bruleed top and dark glaze, mixed salad greens, sautéed bacon strips, toasted pine nuts, pumpkin seeds, raisins, and a wide-rimmed white ceramic bowl. Exactly one thick goat cheese round centered on top of the greens. Nothing else added. New composition by a professional food photographer: close three-quarter angle at 25 degrees, camera positioned lower to showcase the height and caramelized crust of the goat cheese, 85 mm lens at f/3.2, the white bowl sits in the lower 60% of the frame angled slightly, leaving deep clean negative space across the upper third for typography. Directional hard side-light carving sharp highlights on the glaze and bacon, casting the surrounding background into near black, deep black environment with crisp white plate, golden caramelization, and vivid green accents. Photographic realism, no text.
